update_md5_2b937be4748f6e9f1b0c9858bf9d3.name: readme_makerai_build_close_note
update_md5_2b937be4748f6e9f1b0c9858bf9d3.semantics: Add note about closing RagManager before rebuild to avoid locked output exe.
update_md5_2b937be4748f6e9f1b0c9858bf9d3.content_md5_2b937be4748f6e9f1b0c9858bf9d:
Outputs go to `MakerAI/_build/win64/` (demo EXE in `MakerAI/_build/win64/bin/`).
Note: Close `RagManager.exe` before running the build script, otherwise Delphi may fail with “Could not create output file …\\RagManager.exe”.
